shots.action: A locked camera holds on a bus window at night. Raindrops strike the outer glass and cling there, each bead catching a soft point of light. Beyond the pane, the blurred glow of streetlamps and passing headlights drifts slowly through the wet surface, while the dark interior edge of the window frame stays still at the side of the frame.
shots.what_changes: The first drops land and hold on the stationary pane, beginning the scene.

sync_sound: close patter of drops on glass
soft tick of a bead releasing and sliding
shots.action: The shot cuts to a tight view of the wet glass. One large droplet trembles, breaks loose and drags a clean crooked line downward, swallowing smaller beads as it goes; the gathered water thickens and quivers at the bottom of its run, refracting a smeared amber and white glow from the lights outside. The camera remains fixed on the glass.
shots.what_changes: A single droplet breaks free and cuts a running track down the pane, collecting smaller drops.

subjects: gathering water at the lower pane
shots.action: The shot cuts to the window again, now crossed by several wavering trails of water. The streaks distort the night outside into long soft bands of light that slide gently as the rain keeps falling; droplets continue to gather and run while the frame itself does not move.
shots.what_changes: The pane is left marked by multiple running trails that bend the lights outside, and the rain keeps feeding them.

summary.text: Rain runs down a bus window at night in three fixed views.

description.text: A rain-beaded bus window fills the left side of the frame at night, its dark rubber seal and interior edge holding still while cold droplets strike the outer glass. Each new drop catches a small pale point of light and clings in place. Beyond the wet pane, streetlamps and passing headlights dissolve into slow amber and white smears that drift behind the glass. The window surface begins to darken and streak as water gathers, and the night outside remains softly out of focus. The air inside feels close and quiet.
Steady rain patters against the outer glass over a low, muffled traffic hum.
A faint rattle trembles through the bus interior.
Fresh raindrops strike the pane and cling, each catching a soft point of light.
The camera holds a static shot.

An extreme close view of the wet glass isolates one large droplet. It quivers at the edge of its hold, then breaks loose and drags a clean, crooked track downward. Smaller beads merge into the moving bead as it goes, swelling it until gathered water trembles at the bottom of the run. Inside the droplet, the outside lights refract as a smeared amber-white glow that bends and stretches with the water's curve. The surrounding glass is dense with tiny droplets and faint scratches, and the dark night beyond presses close.
The large droplet trembles, breaks free and begins a crooked run down the glass.
Close raindrops tick against the glass around the moving bead.
The running droplet swallows smaller beads and swells at the bottom of its track.
A soft tick marks water releasing and sliding.
The camera holds a static shot.

The window is now crossed by several wavering trails of water. Each trail bends and divides the blurred night into long, soft bands of amber, white and deep blue that slide gently as fresh rain keeps falling. Droplets gather at the lower edge of the pane, fatten and release, feeding new runs through the old ones. The dark frame edge stays steady at the side while the wet surface shifts between clear patches and rippled distortion. The rain continues without pause, leaving the glass marked by moving lines of light.
Several water trails waver across the pane and bend the blurred lights outside.
Rain continues with a steady patter on the glass.
A fresh droplet gathers, releases and feeds a new run through the older streaks.
Distant wet traffic passes with a soft hush.
The camera holds a static shot.
